metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for GSwitch Claude Tool: the Codex plugin (a modified copy of OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc) and the optional router plugin.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: GSwitch Codex plugin: Claude Code sends Codex reviews and tasks to the GSwitch Claude Tool app, which runs them under your Invoke Mode rules. Modified from OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: router
plugins.description: GSwitch router plugin (optional): picks a Claude worker or Codex for each coding task. Codex tasks go through the Codex plugin.
